en.headline: Labour chief says heat-stress warning thresholds under review after record heat
en.dek: Commissioner for Labour Chris Hui admitted the system failed to escalate beyond amber during the recent extreme temperatures and pledged faster adjustments, possibly within the summer.
body: Commissioner for Labour Chris Hui said on Tuesday that the Labour Department is reviewing the trigger thresholds for the three-tier heat stress at work warning after the system remained at the lowest amber level throughout days of record-breaking heat.

Speaking on radio programmes, Hui acknowledged that he and his colleagues had themselves questioned why the warning did not rise to red during the recent extreme conditions. He noted that an April enhancement adding more monitoring stations and a more flexible ratio had not delivered the expected increase in higher-level alerts.

Hui said the department is working with the Hong Kong Observatory and other bodies on options that could include lowering the number of stations required to trigger a higher alert or introducing a multi-track approach that also considers absolute temperature. He hoped changes could be completed within the current summer.

zh.headline: 許澤森：工作暑熱警告門檻將檢視 望暑假內完成
zh.dek: 勞工處處長承認近日破紀錄高溫下警告未有升級，自己亦有問號，正聯同天文台研究下調門檻或引入多軌制，冀今個夏天完成。
body: 勞工處處長許澤森周二在電台節目表示，會檢視及優化工作暑熱警告的啟動門檻，以提高系統敏感度。近日天文台錄得破紀錄高溫，但警告一直維持最低級別黃色，他坦言自己與同事監察時亦充滿問號。
許澤森指出，處方針對今年4月已改良機制，加入多個監測點及較寬鬆比例，原本預期今夏觸發較高級別警告的機會會提高，但近日情況顯示敏感度仍有改善空間。他正聯同天文台等部門探討，研究在極端不尋常高溫下是否需調整啟動較高級別警告的門檻。
對於坊間建議的多軌制及下調監測站達標數量，許澤森證實正認真考慮。他希望盡快完成檢討，例如今個夏天或暑假內可落實。
